anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: not to abolish the law or the prophets but to fulfill.

pass_a_gloss: but since Christ came not to destroy the law or the prophets but to fulfill, he showed us what the true pascha is, the true crossing from Egypt,
pass_b_english: But since Christ came not to abolish the law or the prophets but to fulfill them, he showed us what the true Passover is, the true crossing from Egypt (Matthew 5:17).
source_text: ἐπειδὴ δὲ ὁ Χ(ριστὸ)ς ἦλθεν [οὐ κ]αταλῦσαι τὸν νό[μον] ἢ τ[οὺς] προφήτας ἀλλὰ [πλ]ηρ[ῶσαι, ἔ]δειξεν ἡμῖν τί [τὸ ἀληθινὸν] πάσ[χα, ἡ διάβασι]ς ἡ ἀληθινὴ ἡ [ἐξ Αἰγύπτου,]
